placement_note: Plausible game additions near the authored site route. Survey depths checked against heightmap.bin; runtime placement follows the detailed seabed.

secrets.name: Lost instrument frame
secrets.text: An old instrument frame rests in the canyon sediment. Its open supports once held sensors used to study water and sediment movement.

secrets.name: Whale bones
secrets.text: A small cluster of whale bones lies in a quiet pocket of canyon sediment. Organic remains supply food to scavengers and microbes.

secrets.name: Ledge shelter
secrets.text: A resistant layer forms a low overhang above the softer canyon sediment.
